Interface Equipable

All Superinterfaces:
Item
All Known Implementing Classes:
Armor, Crossbow, Shield, Sword
public interface Equipable extends Item
Represents an item that can be equipped by a PlayerCharacter.

This interface extends Item and adds specific behavior for equippable objects, such as weapons or armor. Implementing classes must define how an item is equipped and unequipped.

By default, calling use(PlayerCharacter) will equip the item, and calling unuse(PlayerCharacter) will unequip it. This avoids code duplication in all equipment classes.
